messages.author: e84fc3fecc615fb7
messages.subject: DT and filters
parts:
Hello, 
I'm trying to set up a DT with scroller extension, but the filters by column are not working

datatable(data.table(mtcars)
                  ,server=FALSE
                  ,filter='top'
                  ,extensions='Scroller'
                  ,options=list(
                      deferRender = TRUE,
                      dom = "rtiS",
                      scrollY = 200,
                      scrollCollapse = TRUE
                  )
        )

Here the package version
 packageVersion("DT")
[1] ‘0.0.26’


What am I doing wrong?
Thanks
Max

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: DT and filters
parts:
You were not doing anything wrong. It is a known issue:
https://github.com/rstudio/DT/issues/41

Regards,
Yihui
